desc: For a day in the field, nothing beats a hardworking dog and a fine Browning shotgun. The Maxus II Ultimate Maple is an ideal shotgun to add to your collection of fine autoloaders. Featuring well-figured AAAA Grade maple with a gloss finish, a beautifully jeweled bolt, and an intricately laser engraved, satin nickel finish receiver, the aesthetics of the Maxus II Ultimate Maple set it apart from other guns.
